R0025.title: Malicious User Poaching
R0025.description: Using comments, private messages, and other means to contact the platform's sponsors, customers, or streamers with the intent of redirecting them to other platforms.
R0025.influence: Disrupts normal platform operations, exposes users to fraud risks, and negatively impacts the company's normal operations.

references.title: Governance Path for Advertising-Promotion Cyber Black-Grey Crime

observables: A single account sends private messages or comments containing external links, WeChat IDs, or phone numbers to a large number of different users within a short window
Private message content matches traffic-diversion script templates (e.g., add WeChat, other platforms), and the sender is a newly registered or low-activity account
The users targeted by concentrated private messaging are high-value groups (sponsors, streamers, recent high-spend customers)
